metadata.description: Excursion Example C: +50V, BK100, 3000 W OPL-MAX, two connectors. Declares a peak of 2.80 at 10 us. The card sits between Example A and Example B: better behaved than the Section 10.1.4 ceiling, but not by the margin Example A claims. A chassis holding eight of these on a shared primary power path cannot absorb eight simultaneous 2.8x transients, which is the budgeting problem the declaration exists to make visible. Pretty-printed for review; a real CID is minified.
